summary: This is a well-scoped, purely additive extension of the existing compliance.prompt_versions table: new major/minor/patch integer columns, a lifecycle_state column backed by both a DB CHECK constraint and a matching TypeScript state machine (ALLOWED_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS), a jsonb metadata column with an accompanying JSON Schema doc, and a rolled_back_from_version_id provenance pointer. The migration uses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS / idempotent constraint-add patterns and backfills lifecycle_state from the pre-existing label column without touching any of the ~20 live resolvePromptTemplate() call sites or existing columns. New service functions (transitionPromptLifecycle, diffPromptVersions, rollbackPromptVersion, nextSemanticVersion) are all gated by the existing veridian_admin role check, use parameterized Drizzle queries (no injection risk), and rollback is correctly append-only (creates a new version rather than mutating history). The line-level LCS diff algorithm is standard and its test cases check out. No .github/workflows/** files are touched. The diff correctly falls into tier2 (schema.ts + drizzle/*.sql) and is already held for human sign-off, which is appropriate given a live migration is involved.
issues: transitionPromptLifecycle() does not call recordAuditTrigger, unlike createPromptVersion and rollbackPromptVersion in the same file which both log to the audit trail — in a compliance-tracking product, promoting a prompt version to Production (or any lifecycle transition) leaving zero audit record is an inconsistency worth closing before or shortly after this ships, even though enforcement/approval-gating is legitimately deferred to phase_3.

Test suite (prompt-os-service.test.ts) was not actually run via `bun test` in the authoring session (bun unavailable in that sandbox) — logic was instead independently reproduced in a standalone Node script per the PROGRESS.md note. This is a reasonable mitigation but real `bun test` execution in CI should be confirmed green before merge, not just assumed from the standalone verification.

rolled_back_from_version_id and prompt_template_id remain unenforced by foreign keys (consistent with the table's pre-existing lack of FKs, so not a new regression, but worth flagging since this PR is the natural point to have added one for the new provenance-pointer column).

drizzle/0262 is not applied to the live database by this task (by design, per stated convention) — a human must apply it before any of this functionality is usable; confirm this is done as part of the sign-off before considering the feature live.
